hook: Two classified USAFE intelligence cables from November 1948 forwarded to General Cabell: one reporting an unidentified aircraft sighting over the Dutch coast by three 307th Bomb Group crews at 30,000 feet, and a second conveying Swedish Air Intelligence's conclusion that flying saucers originate from technology outside Earth, supported by a lake salvage operation that found an uncharted crater.
why_it_matters: This document is significant because it shows, as early as 1948, that senior USAF intelligence officers were seriously entertaining extraterrestrial origin as a non-discredited hypothesis and actively sought allied intelligence input. The Swedish Air Intelligence Service's formal conclusion — that the phenomena cannot be credited to any known culture on Earth — is conveyed not as fringe speculation but as the product of 'reliable and fully technically qualified people.' The cable's closing question, 'What are your reactions?', addressed to General Cabell (director of Air Force Intelligence), indicates the extraterrestrial hypothesis was circulating at the highest levels of Air Force intelligence before Project Blue Book existed.

key_findings.finding: Three bomber crews from the 307th Bomb Group sighted an unidentified aircraft off the west coast of Holland at 30,000 feet on September 5, 1948, exhibiting sudden acceleration and climb beyond the capabilities of known 1947-era jets.

quotes.text: Unidentified aircraft was sighted by three crews of the group at 14022 5 Sep L& off west coast of Holland, 5155N/0355E. Altitude of all aircraft was 30,000 feet. When first sighted the unidentified A/C was cruising at a normal jet speed, heading 12) degrees. Soon after first seen, A/C began leaving smoke trails and condensation trails accompanied by sudden acceleration and then climb.

Generall agreed by observers that it was a single jet propelled A/C employing probably rocket assists with tremendous reserve power, more than normal curising speed for jets of the 1947 variety. Never within ddentification range; its course did not indicate its purpose.

key_findings.finding: Swedish Air Intelligence Service formally concluded that flying saucer phenomena reflect technology that 'cannot be credited to any presently known culture on earth' and may originate from outside the earth — a position conveyed to USAF officers during a direct visit.

quotes.text: Their answer was that some reliable and fully technically qualified people have reached the conclusion that "these phenomena are obviously the result of a high technical skill which cannot be credited to any presently known culture on earth," They are therefore assuming that these objects originate from some previously unknown or unidentified technology, possibly outside the earth.

key_findings.finding: A flying saucer was observed hovering over Neubiberg Air Base for approximately 30 minutes, and the USAFE directorate stated it was convinced the reports 'cannot be disregarded' given the volume and variety of sources.

quotes.text: during the last week, one was observed hovering over Neubiberg Air Base for about thirty minutes. They have been reported by so many sources and from such a variety of places that we are convinced that they cannot be disregarded and must be explained on some basis which is perhaps slightly beyond the scope of our present subelligesee

key_findings.finding: Swedish naval divers were sent to a lake where a flying saucer was reportedly observed crashing or landing, and discovered a previously uncharted crater on the lake floor, which Swedish intelligence attributed to the object.

quotes.text: One of these objects was observed by a Swedish technical expert near his home on the edge of a lake. The object crashed or landed in the lake and he caréfully noted its azimuth from his point of observation. Swedish intelligence was sufficiently confident in his observation that a naval salvage team was sent to the lake.

Divers had discovered a previosuly uncharted erater on the floor of the lake. No further information is available, but we have been promised knowledge of the results, In their opinion, the observation was reliable, and they believe that the depression on the floor of the lake, which did not appear on current Hydrographic charts, was ir fact caused by a flying saucer,

key_findings.finding: The USAFE directorate explicitly stated it was 'inclined not to discredit entirely' the extraterrestrial theory, and solicited General Cabell's reaction — indicating the hypothesis was being formally deliberated at the Air Force intelligence command level in 1948.

quotes.text: Although accepting this theory of the origin of these objects poses a whole new group of Questions and puts much of our thinking in a changed light, we are inclined not to discredit entirely this somewhat spectacular theory, meantime keeping an open mind on the subject. What are your reactions?

legacy_program_connections.reasoning: These 1948 USAFE cables to the Director of Air Force Intelligence are direct precursors to Project Blue Book, documenting the early Air Force saucer reporting chain and the internal debate about extraterrestrial origin that shaped subsequent official investigation programs.

The cables are addressed to General Cabell, Director of Air Force Intelligence, whose office coordinated with Wright-Patterson's Air Material Command on UFO analysis; the USAFE 2 message explicitly forwards reports for 'your inspection and final disposition.'

USAF intelligence officers conducted a direct liaison visit with the Swedish Air Intelligence Service and received their formal UFO assessment, demonstrating active allied intelligence sharing on UAP at the command level in 1948.
